Summaries and Visualizations of the FFAR project

Kelly Adu - Gyamfi

2025-10-25

library(readxl)
FINAL_STANDARD <- read_excel("FINAL_DATA_STANDARDIZED.xlsx")
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
crop_site_crude <- FINAL_STANDARD %>%
  group_by(CROP, SITE) %>%
  summarise(Avg_crude = mean(CRUDE_PROTEIN, na.rm = TRUE))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'CROP'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
crop_site_crude
## # A tibble: 22 × 3
## # Groups:   CROP [6]
##    CROP      SITE    Avg_crude
##    <chr>     <chr>       <dbl>
##  1 Corn      FSRU         9.35
##  2 Corn      FST          7.31
##  3 Corn      ISU          7.27
##  4 Corn      WIT          6.76
##  5 Oats      L&M         12   
##  6 Rye       ISU          7.87
##  7 Spelt     DCF         14.3 
##  8 Spelt     FFAR-AW     11.3 
##  9 Spelt     L&M         14.7 
## 10 Triticale FFAR-AW      8.20
## # ℹ 12 more rows
#heatmap of crop site and crude protein summary
ggplot(crop_site_crude, aes(x = SITE, y = CROP, fill = Avg_crude)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightyellow", high = "darkred") +
  labs(
    title = "Average crude protein by Crop and Site",
    x = "Site", y = "Crop", fill = "Crude Protein"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ergothioneine_summary <- FINAL_STANDARD %>%
  group_by(CROP) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ergothioneine = mean(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ergothioneine = median(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ergothioneine = min(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ergothioneine = max(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(ergothioneine_summary)
## # A tibble: 6 × 5
##   CROP      mean_ergothioneine median_ergothioneine min_ergothioneine
##   <chr>                  <dbl>                <dbl>             <dbl>
## 1 Corn                   11.9                 11.2               2.76
## 2 Oats                   11.7                 11.7              11.7 
## 3 Rye                     7.87                 7.60              7.35
## 4 Spelt                   5.05                 4.88              1.13
## 5 Triticale               7.93                 9.22              1.84
## 6 Wheat                   8.58                 7.97              1.62
## # ℹ 1 more variable: max_ergothioneine <dbl>
ggplot(ergothioneine_summary, aes(x = CROP, y = mean_ergothioneine, fill = CROP)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Ergothioneine Content by Crop",
    x = "Crop",
    y = "Mean Ergothioneine (ng/mg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Top10_ergo <- FINAL_STANDARD %>%
  arrange(desc(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG)) %>%
  select(SWRC_MICRO_ID, CROP, SITE, TREATMENT, ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG) %>%
  head(10)
ggplot(Top10_ergo, aes(x = reorder(SWRC_MICRO_ID, ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG), 
                       y = ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, fill = CROP)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +  # Horizontal bars
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Samples with Highest Ergothioneine",
    x = "Sample ID",
    y = "Ergothioneine (ng/mg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

Top10_protein_score <- FINAL_STANDARD %>%
  arrange(desc(PROTEIN_SCORE)) %>%
  select(SWRC_MICRO_ID, CROP, SITE, TREATMENT, PROTEIN_SCORE) %>%

ggplot(Top10_protein_score, aes(x = reorder(SWRC_MICRO_ID, PROTEIN_SCORE), 
                       y = PROTEIN_SCORE, fill = CROP)) +

  coord_flip() +  # Horizontal bars
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Samples with Highest protein_score",
    x = "Sample ID",
    y = "protein_score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

crop_site_year_ergo_summary <- FINAL_STANDARD %>%
  group_by(CROP, SITE, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG)),
    Mean = ifelse(N > 0, mean(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    Median = ifelse(N > 0, median(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    SD = ifelse(N > 0, sd(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    Min = ifelse(N > 0, min(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    Max = ifelse(N > 0, max(ERGOTHIONEINE_NGMG, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ggplot(crop_site_year_ergo_summary, aes(x = interaction(CROP, SITE), y = Mean, fill = factor(YEAR))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Ergothioneine by Crop, Site, and Year",
    x = "Crop & Site",
    y = "Mean Ergothioneine (ng/mg)",
    fill = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
## Warning: Removed 5 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_bar()`).

crop_site_year_protein_score_summary <- FINAL_STANDARD %>%
  group_by(CROP, SITE, YEAR) %>%

    N = sum(!is.na(PROTEIN_SCORE)),
    Mean = ifelse(N > 0, mean(PROTEIN_SCORE, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    Median = ifelse(N > 0, median(PROTEIN_SCORE, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    SD = ifelse(N > 0, sd(PROTEIN_SCORE, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    Min = ifelse(N > 0, min(PROTEIN_SCORE, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    Max = ifelse(N > 0, max(PROTEIN_SCORE, na.rm = TRUE), NA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ggplot(crop_site_year_protein_score_summary, aes(x = interaction(CROP, SITE), y = Mean, fill = factor(YEAR))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean PROTEIN_SCORE by Crop, Site, and Year",
    x = "Crop & Site",
    y = "Mean PROTEIN_SCORE",
    fill = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
